description: Scroll the page until an element identified by its ref ID is in view, without moving the pointer. Works on a background tab. Refs come from the latest snapshot or action result.
name: browser_scroll_to

ref.description: The element reference from the snapshot (e.g., '@e5')

tab_id.description: Tab to act on, from browser_tabs or browser_tab_create (default: the current tab). Refs belong to the tab they came from. Browser extension only.
